name: io.github.arhancanli/canli-paper-trading-mcp
title: Canli Paper Trading
description: Agent trading on your Alpaca paper account behind pre-trade checks and confirmation tokens.

environmentVariables.name: ALPACA_PAPER_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your Alpaca paper API key id (starts with PK).

environmentVariables.name: ALPACA_PAPER_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Alpaca paper API secret key.

environmentVariables.name: CANLI_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Directory with limits.json, KILL and the order log; default ~/.canli.
